name: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Charging Station (Qi2, foldable)
caption:
One tiny stand charges your phone, watch, and earbuds at once. ⚡

The Anker MagGo 3-in-1 has Qi2 certified 15W magnetic charging for an iPhone, plus spots for an Apple Watch and AirPods. It folds down small for travel.

Tip: Anker recommends a 40W USB-C power adapter, so a weak charger can slow it down.
